Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge, climb animations, wall risers, research gating, PS + TO support, global click-through. W12-15 SHIPPED; §94 PUBLISHED. W18: GL/MapPreview compat REPAIRED (#508). W19: §99 BAND DRESSING — features + biome-parity flora on every level, plus a 7x ground-level count bug fixed; SKY HALF FIELD-VERIFIED #512, BASEMENT HALF NEVER EXERCISED.

**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52-§86 records (index unchanged); **§87 GLOBAL click-through (+§87.b, VERIFIED w17)**; **§88 CE manned weapons (QUEUED)**; **§89 stall (14 sightings; instrumentation ask UNANSWERED)**; §90 disembark tile; §91 PERF PASS; §92 BELOW-VIEW FOG GATE; §93 w15 field reports; **§94 PLANNER (PUBLISHED user-solo; docs debt)**; **§95 VISUAL-FX (A+B, E+E2 FIELD-VERIFIED; §95.j seam fix STILL UNTESTED)**; **§96 WATER (SHIPPED w18, ⚠ UNATTRIBUTED)**; **§97 WORKSHOP TO REPORT (PARKED)**; **§98 W18 AUDIT + GL/MAPPREVIEW REPAIR (FIELD-VERIFIED #508)**; **§99 BAND DRESSING (w19 — SKY HALF FIELD-VERIFIED #512, ⚠ BASEMENT HALF UNEXERCISED)**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE: `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). READ THE V1 FILE FIRST when a V2 feature has an ancestor. `read` refuses that path; `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it.

# 0. START HERE — WINDOW 19

**WINDOW 18 IN ONE PARAGRAPH.** Audit + optimization (§98), then GL + Map Preview compat. Headline: the entire Map Preview bridge had been dead for an unknown number of versions — `Resolve()` threw on its second statement and skipped the step that installs everything. Repaired; landform chain (§56q/§56n/§56m/§56r) FIELD-VERIFIED at #508. §96's water fix shipped but its A/B did not discriminate (§96.e).

**WINDOW 19.** User bug report → **§99 BAND DRESSING**. Non-surface bands were devoid of chunks, features and biome-density vegetation; diagnosis found THREE causes, the third of which nobody had reported because it was invisible: the **ground level had been getting ~1/7 of its correct scatter count since V2 began** (rule 81). Tier 1 built and **FIELD-VERIFIED at #512 — BUT ONLY THE SKY HALF** (the test map was 2 up / 0 down, so no basement band was ever dressed). User closed on "It feels good" (rule 7). Tier 2 (landmarks/mutators, option B) NOT STARTED.

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 19 NEXT MOVES, IN ORDER:**
1. **⚠⚠ §99 BASEMENT HALF IS UNEXERCISED — TEST A DOWN-MAP.** #512 took 2 up / 0 down, so `FillRock`, `CavernGen`, basement dressing, cave debris landing somewhere legal, and the full carve bill were all skipped. Rule 49: a test for A says nothing about B. Also carries the **open-air flora guard (§99.h), added AFTER #512 and therefore BUILT-UNTESTED.**
2. **§99 TIER 2 — LANDMARKS/MUTATORS (option B).** Sketch in §99.f. Tier 1's sky half is verified, which was the gate.
3. **THE PUBLISH PASS** (checklist §31) — carries §94 docs debt + §95 + §87.b + §96 + §98 + §99. Nothing pushed since `f2939e1`; w17, w18 AND w19 work is in autosaves only. ⚠ §96 wording caveat, §96.e. ⚠ §99 IS THE HEADLINE FEATURE OF THIS RELEASE and the ground-level count fix is the most user-visible line in it.
4. **⚠ §95.j static flecks + ABWaterLab — STILL UNTESTED** (w17 carry-over).
5. **⚠ INSTRUMENTATION POLICY DECISION (ask the user)** — promote the one-line per-bridge resolve summary to always-on. Rules 64/5. Asked w15, w16; unanswered.
6. **⚠ THE CARVE IS THE REAL GENERATION BILL** — ledger 10; §99 now adds ~1.1 s on a 2-band-up map. Measure both together on a down-map.
7. Standing queue: E3 (§95.i), §88 CE (queued five windows), §89 (ruling first), §97 parked.

**✅ SHIPPED/LIVE:** w12-15 on Workshop 3776015553 (w15 `f2939e1`); §94 published user-solo. THE WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD — NORMAL (`#if DEBUG` is the off switch; DECOMPILE TO PROVE at publish, rule 17/64).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked — scans COMPAT ONLY; V1 exempt. (2) Building art = USER. (3) About description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N choices. (5) NO NEW INSTRUMENTATION WITHOUT ASKING. (6) A user deferral is a ruling. **(7) THE USER MAY CLOSE AN INVESTIGATION ON "IT WORKS" — record the residual uncertainty and move on.**

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (standing):** §91.c DORMANT; §90 elevator-fallback + walled-front-tile; §85 flipped up-link approachCells; §62.N, §70; §62.M, §66c, §66e. **⚠ VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT:** §94.g FLIP (never log-captured); §96 square `_MapSize` (§96.e); **§99 SKY HALF ONLY (§99.e)**. **⚠ BUILT-UNTESTED:** **§99 basement dressing + §99.h open-air flora guard**; §95.j seam fix + ABWaterLab attribute (w17); §56p biome-transition suppression; §98's C-items. **✅ FIELD-VERIFIED:** §56q/§56n/§56m/§56r + MapPreviewCompat repair (#508); §99 sky dressing + surface count fix (#512).

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17 revs):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS. 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX + decompile the binary. 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL. 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO + COUNT PER-CLASS FAILURES. 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT — LAB OVER THEORY. 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT — and so do FOREIGN FIELD NAMES. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER. 77 A REVERTED FIX MAY HAVE BEEN CORRECT ARITHMETIC ON A POISONED INPUT. 78 ONE `try` AROUND N LOOKUPS MAKES N FEATURES ONE FEATURE. 79 A HOST THAT SKIPS GENSTEPS GIVES ITS GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS. 80 A FIX THAT CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF AGAIN IS A FIX YOU CANNOT ATTRIBUTE.
**⚠ 81 (w19) A DIMENSION THE ENGINE NEVER READS CANNOT PROTECT YOU.** `GenStep_Scatterer.CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and never touches `Size.z` or `map.Area`. Every banded map has therefore been issued ONE band's worth of geysers/chunks/vents and spraying it over seven. READ THE ARITHMETIC before assuming a vanilla count scales with area.
**⚠ 82 (w19) TO INHERIT A MOD'S CONTENT, RUN ITS CODE, NOT ITS DEFS.** ReGrowth 2's boulders have no def and no genstep of their own — they are a TRANSPILER on vanilla's `GenStep_RockChunks`. Any "re-run generation for X" feature must re-run the real genstep under a redirect; a def-based reimplementation cannot see injected IL.
**⚠ 83 (w19) LIE ABOUT THE MAP AT THE THREE CELL FUNNELS, NOT AT THE CALLERS.** `Map.AllCells`, `cellsInRandomOrder.GetAll()` and `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` are where essentially every genstep asks "where may I put things". Redirect those three at one rect and foreign generation code becomes band-aware for free.
**⚠ 84 (w19) TAKING OVER A JOB INHERITS ITS PRECONDITIONS, NOT ITS GUARDS.** Handing flora to vanilla's spawner silently dropped the `Standable` test our own seeders had — and vanilla has NO equivalent (§99.h). When replacing hand-rolled code with the engine's own, enumerate what the old code checked that the new path does not.

# 96. WATER RENDER PARITY — **SHIPPED w18; ⚠⚠ WORKS, MECHANISM UNATTRIBUTED**

**96.a PIPELINE:** `WaterInfo.SetTextures` runs per frame from `Map.MapUpdate` and publishes `_WaterOutputTex`, `_WaterReflectionTex`, camera params, `_WaterOffsetTex`, and as its LAST statement `_MapSize` = (x, z). Compiled shader unreadable.
**96.b THE SHIPPED FIX (`ABWaterMapSize.cs`):** on banded maps only, republish `_MapSize` as (x, bandHeight). Stands down while the lab drives. Dev toggle: `AB2: water - toggle SHIPPED band _MapSize fix`.
**96.c DELIVERY — SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT (#509):** `0 of 6 water depth material(s) declare _MapSize`. Material-local shadowing was NEVER possible. Global is the only delivery that can work, and it is inherently water-scoped (`_MapSize` written in EXACTLY ONE place in vanilla).
**96.d MECHANISM (plausible, not proven):** shader UVs surface by `worldPos.xz / _MapSize`; (126, 896) divides z seven times harder than x.
**96.e ⚠⚠ WHAT #509 DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH.** Fix ON → water correct. Fix OFF → streaking did NOT return, so the A/B did not discriminate. Three live possibilities: (A) `_MapSize` is not the cause and something else in w18 fixed it (likely §56n/§56r or `ABWaterBand.ToSurfaceBand`); (B) the toggle did not take; (C) the ocean tile never reproduced a symptom first reported on a LAKE. **USER CLOSED ON "it works fine" (rule 7).** **⚠ 30-SECOND PROTOCOL:** `paint test pond` → `report+` (expect `(126,126)`) → toggle OFF → `report+` (expect `(126,896)`) → look. Rule 80. **⚠ RELEASE NOTES: do not claim a mechanism.**

# 98. W18 AUDIT + GL / MAP PREVIEW REPAIR — **FIELD-VERIFIED #508**

**98.a THE AUDIT.** 135 files / 50,336 lines / 357 types / 1,236 methods. 12 dead methods; 28 clone pairs; 16 cache-hostile loops; 54 silent catches of 303. ⚠ Pass-3 reachability OVER-REPORTS.
**98.b THE ROOT CAUSE.** `AccessTools.Method(sizeUtilType, "DetermineMapSize")` threw AmbiguousMatchException as the SECOND statement inside `Resolve()`'s single try, aborting the whole method. **The Map Preview bridge had been 100% dead for an unknown number of versions.** Fixes: `FindDetermineMapSize()` selects by SHAPE; `Resolve()` per-step isolated with `RaiseSizeCaps` LAST (rule 78).
**98.c THE LANDFORM CHAIN.** `ElevationFertility(10) → MutatorPostElevationFertility(20) → RocksFromGrid(200) → Terrain(210) → MutatorPostTerrain(220)`. §56q SIZE; §56n POLLUTION; §56m IMPORT (legal only because §56n — rule 77); §56r DECISION CONTEXT (`ABGLContextBorrow`).
**98.d VERIFICATION (#508).** `context=SURFACE(15876 cells borrowed)`; authored cells 1,893 → 7,159; no leak. ⚠ "anchor water == surface water" is NOT the criterion. ⚠ Previews author MORE than the colony and that is CORRECT (rule 79).
**98.e DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED.** C4 `CompMemo` readonly fields; riverFlowMap lift loop; `SectionLayer_ABBelowSnow` L110/L267; Shadows L156 / V2Water L260; 11 remaining dead methods.
**98.f WHAT ELSE SHIPPED.** §56p `Patch_GL_ABBiomeTransitionScope`; `ABBandedGeneration.RealGenerationInFlight`; 9 GL transplant loops reordered; `ABMapSizeLimit.ChooserStrings` memo.
**98.g TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTICS STILL IN THE BUILD** (all `ABLog.Dev`): Map Preview transform CALLED; FALLBACK postfix fired; inferred layout ACCEPTED/DECLINED; DetermineMapSize -> N-arg overload; context=SURFACE(N); band water _MapSize.
**98.h KNOWN REMAINING GAP.** Context borrow covers the TERRAIN pass only; the ELEVATION pass gates caves on `elevation[c] > 0.7f` read at anchor rows. Not observed. ⚠ Snapshot ordering is the trap.

# 99. BAND DRESSING — EVERY LEVEL IS A REAL LEVEL — **SKY HALF FIELD-VERIFIED #512**

**99.a THE REPORT (user, w19).** "Upper bands (and lower) devoid of rock chunks, vegetation (too sparse for biome) and features (lakes, vents, etc) including Odyssey landmarks and Vanilla Landmarks Expanded. Steam Geysers, Helixian Gas Vents, and Boulders from Regrowth 2. Anima trees should be level bounded to the ground level, and ancient wreckage, including from mods like Vanilla Vehicles Expanded and Vehicle Framework or the vanilla Mechanitor should never spawn in lower levels." **User rulings when asked:** flora = vanilla's own pass, mod-aware, PARITY (drop the alpine rim curve); features = GENERALISE (auto-detect + blocklist); landmarks = OPTION B; wreckage = **ground level only, ALL other bands**, specifically the PROPS + mechanitor wreckage, not the broad ruins/slag category.

**99.b THE DIAGNOSIS — THREE CAUSES.**
1. **THE CARVE IS TOTAL AND RUNS LAST.** Every genstep generates across the whole map, then our `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix erases every non-surface band and rebuilds it. Nothing re-placed what it erased.
2. **THE INITIAL PLANT PASS WAS DELIBERATELY SUPPRESSED** on doomed bands (a correct perf fix). Band flora was our constants only: sky `0.16 × plantDensity` thinned as far as ×0.30 by the alpine rim curve; cavern `0.08 × plantDensity`.
3. **⚠⚠ THE GROUND LEVEL WAS SHORT TOO — UNREPORTED, LATENT SINCE V2 BEGAN.** `CountFromPer10kCells` squares `map.Size.x` and never reads `Size.z`/`map.Area`, so the map is issued a 126×126 count and vanilla sprays it over seven bands. **Rule 81.**

**99.c THE MECHANISM — `ABBandScope`.** Rather than reimplementing gensteps (impossible — rule 82), lie to them at **three cell funnels (rule 83)**: `Map.AllCells` (prefix → band `CellRect`), `MapCellsInRandomOrder.GetAll` (postfix → band-filtered shuffle), `GenStep_Scatterer.TryFindScatterCell` (prefix → samples the band, calls the instance's OWN `CanScatterAt` virtually via cached `MethodInfo.Invoke`, rule 36). Veto half lives INSIDE `Patch_GenStep_Scatterer_ABBandSeam` (rule 50). Single-slot; nested `Push` is a hard error; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on leak. `rejectOpenAir` for SKY bands. **Sweep budget = 2 per `Generate`**: `CanScatterAt` only ever gets more restrictive as `usedSpots` grows, and 2 is the exact number of distinct predicates (normal + `useFallback`) — rule 74.

**99.d WHAT SHIPPED IN TIER 1.** `ABBandDressing.Dress` called from the tail of `CarveInner` — after `CarveGutters` (nothing can straddle a seam) and BEFORE the basement refog. **⚠ It runs under `CarveInProgress`, which is load-bearing: `ABAirSpawnGuard` would otherwise walk every geyser back onto the surface, as it walked 18,075 basement rocks upstairs at run #46 (§57).** Genstep capture is a Prefix on `GenerateContentsIntoMap` reading the ARGUMENT (not `MapGeneratorDef.genSteps`, which misses runtime injections — rule 62). Eligibility = capability → shape → names: include `GenStep_RockChunks` (vanilla loose rock AND ReGrowth 2's boulders via their transpiler) and any `GenStep_Scatterer` that is not `isJunk`, not `nearPlayerStart`/`nearMapCenter`, and misses the blocklist fragments. Per-band reseed `HashCombine(tile, def.index, band*7919)`. Flora = vanilla's `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` with the real density factor and whole-map demand, **both read OUTSIDE every scope** (a scoped read of `CurrentWholeMapNumDesiredPlants` would saturate every band at a seventh of the right density) and **no scope armed during the flora pass**. Composes with existing seeders (vanilla refuses occupied cells) so ABCavernGen's cave flora survives; **ABSkyBandGen's `SeedFlora` stands down (rim curve gone = the requested parity) and registers as a zero-yield fallback**. `Patch_GenStep_ABSurfaceBandScope` confines the ORIGINAL pass to the surface band, fixing 99.b(3) and deleting the wasted spawns. `ABGroundOnly` pins special trees via `GenStep_SpecialTrees.CanSpawnAt` — the one predicate BOTH map-gen and `IncidentWorker_AnimaTreeSpawn` funnel through; **the incident path was covered by nothing at all before**. Settings `bandFeatures` / `bandVegetationParity` (both default true); `skyVegetationDensity` now scales vanilla's factor so 1.0 is true parity.

**99.e ⚠⚠ VERIFICATION #512 — WHAT IT DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH.**
Map (190,1,576), 3 bands of 190, slot 192, **surface band 0, 2 UP / 0 DOWN**, TemperateForest / Mountainous, mutators Mountain+Caves, companions ReGrowth 2 + Vanilla Helixien Gas. Log mtime confirmed newer than dll (rule 17). Result: `Band dressing complete: 8 genstep run(s), 349 thing(s), 9,619 plant(s), 3 open-air cell(s) refused.` `BandDressing band 1` 666.2 ms, `band 2` 332.0 ms, total 1,056.9 ms; carve 1,328.1 ms; all gensteps 3,089.1 ms. **No `ABBandScope LEAKED`, no exception, no wreckage audit warning, one error class all session and it was our own profiler.** User: "It feels good" (rule 7).
**⚠ WHAT WAS NOT EXERCISED — DO NOT READ THIS AS A FULL PASS:**
  * **THE ENTIRE BASEMENT HALF.** 0 down bands, so `FillRock`, `CavernGen`, basement dressing, cave-plant parity and cave debris finding legal ground were never run. Rule 49.
  * **The wreckage decoration-window path** — VVE / Vehicle Framework were not loaded. The silent audit is positive evidence only for the genstep half.
  * **Anima placement** was never visually confirmed; the genstep ran (2.2 ms) but where its tree landed is unknown.
